arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The defendant argued the Third Circuit erred. It claimed the court ignored overbreadth analysis.
The government argued the law targets conduct. It claimed the statute is narrowly tailored.
Chief Justice Roberts noted the law requires content review. He questioned the government's claim of content neutrality.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on a federal statute. It bans selling depictions of animal cruelty. The defendant claims this violates free speech rights. The government claims the law targets illegal acts.
